recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-19767; any future cleanup of source/codesystem/loinc.xml should be handled as a separate build-scope or repository hygiene decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocabulary WG issue for STU3 requesting that the LOINC STATUS property type be changed from code to string, with the related wording correction from "LOINC tables fields" to "LOINC table fields".
initial_application: Git commit 9a9bf70d87c3fb066f70968afa5f95372bd92f94 pre-applied the issue by updating source/loinc.html so the LOINC Properties table listed STATUS as string and by fixing the table-field wording. The separate tracked source/codesystem/loinc.xml file was not changed by that commit and currently still contains a stale STATUS boolean row.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed source/loinc.html during the external terminology page migration and updated the current build-scoped Code Systems page to link LOINC usage guidance to THO. The current THO English LOINC page has the migrated LOINC Properties table and lists STATUS as string. source/codesystem/loinc.xml is not listed in source/fhir.ini [codesystems], and no current tracked source reference to codesystem/loinc.xml was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current FHIR build points implementers to the authoritative migrated THO LOINC page, which already reflects the FHIR-19767 decision; editing the unreferenced local XML artifact would not fix current build output and would exceed the build-scope threshold.

related_jiras.note: Removed the old FHIR-core external terminology pages, including source/loinc.html, and migrated LOINC usage guidance to THO links. It is already represented on the combined branch.
Implemented the THO-side migration of external terminology usage pages; the active THO LOINC page now carries the STATUS=string table.
